capabilities.target: packaged CLI specification, project Forme config/content, and local package manifests
capabilities.justification: Loads the declarative CLI Builder specification, the selected project config/content, and local file dependencies for builds, watch mode, and the repository bootstrap helper.

capabilities.target: selected Forme project root excluding generated output, cache, dependency, and VCS trees
capabilities.justification: Coalesces authored project changes into conservative full-pipeline preview rebuilds.
The watch command serves successful in-memory preview artifacts and live-reload events on loopback.

capabilities.target: configured cache and DeployArtifact output directories beneath the project root
capabilities.justification: Implements the explicit forme clean command with containment checks.

capabilities.target: configured project cache and user-selected deterministic JSON build report
capabilities.justification: Persists deterministic pure-stage entries beneath the configured project cache and writes the optional --report manifest after a successful build.

capabilities.target: configured project cache and parent directories for the user-selected build report
capabilities.justification: Creates cache shards beneath the configured project directory and missing report parent directories.

capabilities.target: npm install for local file dependencies
capabilities.justification: The repository-only bootstrap helper installs local file dependencies in deterministic leaf-first order.
Observes Ctrl-C and propagates cooperative cancellation through the running pipeline.
Prints command summaries and stable machine-coded diagnostics for terminal and CI consumers.

justification: The headless CLI loads project configuration, removes explicitly configured build state, handles SIGINT, and provides a repository bootstrap helper. It does not access the network except indirectly when the user invokes the bootstrap helper and npm resolves declared dependencies.
